title: Storage root is .kaava/ directory, not sdd/
context: Earlier wireframe status bar showed `sdd/` as the storage root. This is the actual directory name used.
decision: The storage root for all Schematify project data is `.kaava/` not `sdd/`. This aligns with the project-manifest convention (`<name>.kaava` files) and distinguishes it from the stack-level manifest `kaava.toml`.
consequences: Directory naming is consistent with the project manifest naming; `.kaava` is clearly a project-scoped directory; wave 2 updates the status bar to draw `.kaava/` instead of `sdd/`.
